mapper.select: SELECT protocol_id as protocolId, protocol_name as protocolName, version_list as versionList, tile_grid_set as tileGridSet, support_format as supportFormat from server_protocol_info spi where spi.protocol_name ~* #{serviceName} AND spi.version_list ~* #{version}

SELECT id as id, title_name AS titleName, abstract_name AS abstractName, keywords AS keywords, online_resource AS onLineResource, contact_Organization AS organization, web_site AS webSite, contact_person AS contactPerson, person_primary AS primary, contact_telephone AS telephone, contact_fax AS fax, address AS address, city AS city, province AS province, country AS country, postcode AS postcode, email_address AS email FROM server_provider_info

SELECT layer_group_info.group_id as LayerGroupId, layer_group_info.layer_Name as layerName, layer_group_info.style_name as styleName, layer_group_info.min_level as minLevel, layer_group_info.max_level as maxlevel from layer_group_info, map_server_info where map_server_info.server_id = layer_group_info.group_id and map_server_info.layer_name = #{layerName}
SELECT server_status from map_server_info where map_server_info.layer_name = #{layerName}

select id as id, map_pyramid_info.server_id as serverId, reolution as resolution, map_pyramid_info.file_url as fileUrl from map_pyramid_info,map_server_info where map_server_info.server_id = map_pyramid_info.server_id and map_server_info.layer_name = #{layerName}
select style_id as styleId, file_name as fileName, style_name as sldName, type_id as typeId from style_info where (style_name = #{styleName} or style_id = #{styleName})

select map_server_info.layer_name as layerName, map_feature_info.resource_crs as resourceSrs, map_feature_info.tile_extension as resourceFormat, map_feature_info.native_crs as nativeSrs, map_feature_info.tile_width as tileWidth, map_feature_info.tile_height as tileHeight, map_server_info.file_url as filePath, map_server_info.file_type as fileType, map_server_info.data_type as dataType, map_feature_info.zoom_level as supportMaxLevel, map_server_info.server_status as status, map_server_info.pulished_proctol as supportProtocal, map_server_info.description as description, map_feature_info.resource_bbox as resourceBbox, map_feature_info.tile_origin_flag as origin, map_feature_info.sea_chart_identifier as seaChartIdentifier, map_feature_info.native_bbox as nativaBbox from map_feature_info left join map_server_info on map_server_info.server_id = map_feature_info.server_id where map_server_info.server_name = #{serverName}

select group_id as LayerGroupId, layer_Name as layerName, style_name as styleName, remote_url as remoteUrl, server_type as serverType, ogc_protocal as ogcProtocal, min_level as minLevel, max_level as maxlevel from layer_group_info where layer_Name = #{serverName} order by id
select mfi.sea_chart_scale from map_feature_info mfi, map_server_info msi WHERE mfi.server_id = msi.server_id and msi.layer_name = #{serverName}

SELECT lgi.group_id as LayerGroupId, lgi.layer_Name as layerName, lgi.style_name as styleName, lgi.min_level as minLevel, lgi.max_level as maxlevel, mfi.native_crs as nativeCrs, mfi.native_bbox as nativeBbox from layer_group_info lgi left join map_server_info msi on msi.server_id = lgi.group_id left join map_feature_info mfi on msi.server_id = mfi.server_id where msi.layer_name = #{layerName} order by lgi.id
select data_type from map_server_info where server_name = #{serverName}
select is_layer_group from map_server_info where server_name = #{serverName}

select data_source_name as dataSourceName, database_name as databaseName, database_ip as databaseIp, port as port, user_name as userName, password as password, db_type as dbType from post_gis_info where data_source_name = #{sourceName}
